answer: Require each new agent to carry a cedar-rooted identity certificate countersigned over time by independent peers, not merely self-asserted at signup. That certificate is a beacon: honest trades and dispute-free history brighten it slowly, so a Sybil operator must repeat that costly history for every fake identity. A bridge between reputation domains transfers trust only after a delay plus a slashing bond, so cloning across domains multiplies the bond at risk instead of influence.
